name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
eligibility: Girl students who studied from Class 6 to 12 in Government schools in Tamil Nadu and are currently pursuing a degree, diploma, or ITI course.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month credited directly to the student's bank account until completion of course.

name: First Graduate Scholarship
eligibility: Residents of Tamil Nadu who are the first in their family to pursue graduation. Requires a First Graduate Certificate from the Tahsildar.
deadline: Applied during college counseling/admission phase (typically June-August)
benefits: Complete waiver of tuition fees in Government colleges and fee concession in self-financing colleges.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Minorities (NSP)
eligibility: Students from minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) with 50% marks in previous exam and family income < ₹2.0 Lakhs.
benefits: Admission and tuition fees reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance.

name: PM-USP (Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students)
eligibility: Students above 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12 of the respective Board of Examination with family income < ₹4.5 Lakhs.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year for first 3 years of UG; ₹20,000 per year for PG/Professional courses.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
eligibility: Students in the top 1% of their Class 12 board results pursuing bachelor's or master's in Natural and Basic Sciences.
benefits: ₹80,000 per year including a fixed scholarship and a summer research project allowance.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
eligibility: Girl students admitted in 1st year degree/diploma technical courses with family income < ₹8 Lakhs. Max 2 per family.
benefits: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study as a lump sum for academic incidentals.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/SCC (Tamil Nadu)
eligibility: TN resident students belonging to SC/ST or Adi Dravidar Converts (SCC) with family income < ₹2.5 Lakhs.
benefits: Reimbursement of all non-refundable fees (tuition/hostel) plus a monthly maintenance allowance.
